calibration_parameter_notes.demand.class_parameters.*.active_size_di: Approximate demand-size family shape rounded to a coarse half-unit grid and perturbed.
calibration_parameter_notes.demand.class_parameters.*.active_size_me: Approximate active-demand center rounded to whole units and perturbed one grid step.
calibration_parameter_notes.demand.class_parameters.*.zero_probabili: Approximate private zero-period share rounded to five percentage points and perturbed one grid step.
calibration_parameter_notes.demand.class_proportions.*: Real class share rounded to a five-percentage-point grid.
calibration_parameter_notes.named_parts.*: Coarse, perturbed behaviour of a real part category with at least four parts; no single part's values.
calibration_parameter_notes.reliability.age_effect_direction: Qualitative direction only; no private coefficient is retained.
calibration_parameter_notes.reliability.age_effect_strength: Qualitative weak/moderate category only; no private magnitude is retained.
calibration_parameter_notes.reliability.weibull_scale_hours_range: Family-level private fit range reduced to coarse 500-hour endpoints and expanded/perturbed.
calibration_parameter_notes.reliability.weibull_shape_range: Family-level private fit range reduced to coarse quarter-unit endpoints and expanded/perturbed.
calibration_parameter_notes.telemetry.daily_hours_spread: Approximate positive-use spread rounded to whole hours and perturbed.
calibration_parameter_notes.telemetry.missing_rate: Approximate coverage gap rounded to five percentage points and perturbed.
calibration_parameter_notes.telemetry.positive_daily_hours_center: Approximate positive-use center rounded to whole hours and perturbed.

corrective_share_by_class.note: Share of each class's parts that are mechanical corrective (the original schedule's scope), rounded to five percentage points.

erratic.note: Approximate zero share and active-demand size shape, rounded coarsely and perturbed.

intermittent.note: Approximate zero share and active-demand size shape, rounded coarsely and perturbed.

lumpy.note: Approximate zero share and active-demand size shape, rounded coarsely and perturbed.

smooth.note: Approximate zero share and active-demand size shape, rounded coarsely and perturbed.

class_proportions.note: Real class mix from the project's own ADI/CV2 classification, rounded to five percentage points.

installed_base.note: Median trucks carrying a part and units per replacement line, rounded and perturbed.

modeling.note: Same settings as the original project; replica results are checked for fidelity against the original.

privacy.notes: No row-level values, identifiers, exact counts, exact fits, financial figures, downtime figures, or original model metrics are retained.
privacy.status: rounded and deterministically perturbed aggregate calibration

rare_tail.note: Share of scheduled parts too sparse for a reliability fit and their median installed trucks, rounded and perturbed.

reliability.note: Ranges are coarse rounded/perturbed family-level calibration; covariates encode direction and qualitative strength, never an original coefficient.

telemetry.note: Approximate utilization and coverage patterns, rounded to whole hours or five percentage points and perturbed.
